source: User-supplied JJP Launch System, Edition I; image-production adaptation
style: cinematic live-action realism, grounded physical materials, thoughtful film lighting, dignified performances, no rendered lettering
negative: anime, cartoon, manga, illustration, plastic skin, watermark, illegible text, human-faced villain, shame-based imagery, exploitative grief imagery

Verdict of the Lamb.world: A cosmic courtroom, thunder beyond monumental arches, broken chains, a faceless shadow accuser made of smoke; the human leads stand in mercy and resolve.
Verdict of the Lamb.palette: crimson light against charcoal black, restrained ivory highlights

Anastasis.world: The courtroom world opens into an empty-tomb garden at dawn, darkness transforming into resurrection light; no accuser present.
Anastasis.palette: crimson transitioning to sunrise gold and living green

God-Breathed.world: A twilight battlefield with broken swords, illuminated scripture scrolls and chains opening into light; a lone warrior-scribe faces non-human darkness.
God-Breathed.palette: charcoal, deep crimson, warm scroll light

Every Thought Captive.world: A symbolic war room inside a mind, neural grids and faceless glitch-static entities giving way to a quiet river of light.
Every Thought Captive.palette: dark indigo, cyan grid light, white peace

Present Your Body.world: A sunset hillside becomes a starlit garden; opened shackles and new growth communicate renewal without spectacle.
Present Your Body.palette: golden hour amber, living green, warm night blue

Jesus, Thank You For Loving Me.world: An intimate empty-tomb garden at sunrise; one grateful worshipper, soft light, no armies or towers.
Jesus, Thank You For Loving Me.palette: soft sunrise gold, warm ivory, muted garden green

Mirror of Glory.world: A lone mirror in a golden desert reflects a transformed world of light; the seeker is faceless and cloaked.
Mirror of Glory.palette: sandstone gold, desert blue, luminous ivory

Love Your Enemies.world: A Galilean hillside in a sun-shower, rain and light falling across the whole scene; the second lead carries the moment and the first is a distant silent listener.
Love Your Enemies.palette: rain silver, fresh green, gentle gold

cast_rule: Only approved human leads represent the recurring cast; evil entities remain non-human and faceless. The seeker is faceless and cloaked.
